card.name: Words just before "monitored"
card.fires_on: The word right before a form of "monitor" in label warnings, such as "be" after "should", "MON" in capitalized "MONITORED", or "Clos" in "Closely monitor".

modes.description: The word "be" after "should" or a patient subject, where "monitored" comes next.

modes.label: Closely before monitor
modes.description: The start of "Closely" when it opens an instruction to monitor.
